content.text: Gentiles -- A near and a far fulfilment of these prophecies against Gentile powers are to be distinguished. In Chapter 46, the near vision is of a Babylonian invasion of Egypt, but verses Jeremiah 46:27,28 look forward to the judgment of the nations. (See Scofield "Matthew 25:32"), after Armageddon Revelation 16:14, See Scofield "Revelation 19:17" and the deliverance of Israel ("Israel," Genesis 12:2,3 See Scofield "Romans 11:26"). Jeremiah 50:4-7 also looks forward to the last days.
day of the Lord -- See Day (of Jehovah) note, (See Scofield "Isaiah 2:12").
